Name: Verification Flow for High Performance Cores, Accelerators and Demonstrators
Description: A generic simulator interface shell to shield specialties of open-source simulators (e.g. Verilator), commercial simulators (e.g. Incisive) and free usable simulators (e.g. Vivado) so that they can be used exchangeable. The shell is part of a framework that also shields formal verification and linting
